title: add Bottlerocket & PhotonOS runtime bundles, vendored rpm/apt assets, and bridge CNI for bare-metal airgap installs
author: Ananya Rao
description: Motivation: Several enterprise customers requested first-class support for immutable-node OSes in fully air-gapped/private installs. Bottlerocket (AWS customers) and PhotonOS (VMWare) have different packaging and init assumptions compared to our current Almalinux/Rocky flows. This PR provides vendored runtime bundles, package mirrors, and a lightweight bridge CNI that enables bare-metal load-balancer topologies without requiring external overlay networks. Summary: 1) Added two new offline bundles: bundles/bottlerocket-runtime.tar.gz and bundles/photonos-runtime.tar.gz with minimal required packages (containerd, iptables-nft shim, kubelet runtime deps) and pre-seeded kubelet/kubectl binaries. 2) Implemented apt/rpm metadata vendoring pipeline updates (scripts/mirror-vendor.sh) that produce deterministic delta-manifests for airgap syncs and signature artifacts for GPG rotation. 3) Introduced installer/overlays/bridge-cni: a minimal CNI plugin plus Helm chart values and a post-install hook that programs host bridges for MetalLB-style bare-metal services. 4) Terraform: updated terraform/modules/registry to support mirrored registries with a dual-registry fallback config and added instructions to terraform/README-airgap.md. 5) Helm charts: redwood-helm-charts/private/templates/cni-bridge.yaml and values for toggling bridge vs overlay, plus healthchecks and RBAC rules. 6) Upgrade/rollback: delta bundle generation now produces per-OS checksums and atomic manifest files consumed by the offline-upgrade controller to enable safe rollback on read-only root filesystems. Testing and CI: added integration job that runs install tests in a local KVM environment using Bottlerocket/Photon images (qemu). The initial CI run failed linting for packaging scripts; fixed by adding shellcheck exceptions and clarifying env var usage. Backwards compatibility: default path remains unchanged; behavior is opt-in via --os=bottlerocket|photon or helm value private.os.type. Documentation: added docs/airgap-bottlerocket.md and docs/airgap-photon.md with step-by-step registry mirroring and validation checklist. Risks: Bottlerocket's read-only root necessitates extra care for kubelet logs and runtime mounts; this PR includes documented mitigations and a follow-up issue for centralized log adapters. Checklist: - [x] vendor bundles created - [x] mirror scripts updated - [x] bridge CNI added + Helm values - [x] Terraform registry module hooks - [x] integration tests (local qemu) - [x] docs and upgrade manifest examples.
